flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui pages/Furnish/{Acknowledgement.ts, Confirmation.ts (successful submit -> InitSuccess), Summary.ts, NoticesTable/{FurnishedNotices.ts, Column.ts}}; ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish/{FurnishSubmissionController (response noticeCount/submittedAt/txnNo), FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl.generateTxnNo}. No PDF generation/download code for this page in the six repos. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant.
note: Status Fully paid; 3 points. The acknowledgement page exists and is complete for 'URA has received', reference number, notice count, date-time, the notice table and the hirer/driver particulars. For 'print/download in PDF' there is only a Print button that calls window.print() (Acknowledgement.ts:139-144); there is no Download button, no PDF library/endpoint (grep for pdf/download/jspdf/html2canvas in pages/Furnish only finds a MIME mapping for document upload), and no @media print rule specific to this page in ocmseserviceui/src. Saving as PDF is only possible through the browser print dialog. Watch out: the notice table uses pageSize 10 (FurnishedNotices.ts:49), so when more than 10 notices are submitted the printout may only contain the table page currently shown; this cannot be verified from the repo (needs a print test). The owner/company particulars are intentionally hidden on this page (Summary.ts:298-308). Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-110, OCMS-DF-2026-143, OCMS-DF-2026-175 (generic error screen on submit, Closed) and OCMS-DF-2026-191 (WOGAA tracking for Furnish, Ready to PRD) do not change the content of the acknowledgement page.
recommendation: Claim partially: acknowledgement and summary match; there is no 'download PDF' button or code, only the browser Print. Do not claim a PDF download feature.

steps.step: After a successful submit, the UI switches to the acknowledgement page
steps.detail: When APIPostFurnish has no failures, Confirmation fills acknowledgement.formData, calls InitSuccess() and sets isCompleted = true (Confirmation.ts:181-190); InitSuccess builds the page content (Acknowledgement.ts:215-243). When the submit fails, an error screen is shown (Acknowledgement.ts:246-258), not the acknowledgement. History of the generic error screen: OCMS-DF-2026-110, OCMS-DF-2026-143, OCMS-DF-2026-175 (all Closed).

steps.step: The page states URA has received the submission, with reference number, notice count and date-time
steps.detail: StatusSuccess shows 'Your submission has been received', Submission Reference No., Number of Notice(s) Furnished and Submission Date & Time (Acknowledgement.ts:42-67). The values come from the backend response: the txnNo from generateTxnNo (FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl.java:136), noticeCount and submittedAt (FurnishSubmissionController.java:208-212), mapped in Confirmation.ts:159-166.

steps.step: The page shows a summary of the notices that were furnished
steps.detail: furnished-notices-section with FurnishedColumns: Submission Date, Notice Number, Vehicle Number, Offence Date & Time, Place of Offence, Furnished Hirer/Driver Name (Column.ts:60-67; Acknowledgement.ts:221-228). The table uses pageSize 10 (FurnishedNotices.ts:49), so more than 10 notices are split across pages.

steps.step: The page shows a summary of the particulars furnished
steps.detail: furnish-summary with isAcknowledgement = true (Acknowledgement.ts:230-236) renders the hirer/driver particulars, the question answers and the supporting documents (Summary.ts:310-316). Owner/company particulars are hidden in this mode (Summary.ts:298-308); the story says 'particulars furnished', meaning the hirer/driver data, so it is treated as matching.

steps.step: The user can print the acknowledgement page
steps.detail: The 'Print' button calls window.print() (Acknowledgement.ts:139-144) and is shown in InitSuccess (Acknowledgement.ts:241). The printed result (layout, tables over 10 rows) cannot verify from repo because there is no print stylesheet specific to this page.

steps.step: The user can download a copy in PDF format
steps.detail: There is no Download button and no PDF generation code in ocmseserviceui (pages/Furnish) or ocmseserviceapi (no PDF endpoint for furnish). The only route is window.print() (Acknowledgement.ts:143), after which the user chooses 'Save as PDF' in the browser dialog; that is a browser feature, not an application feature. Marked Sebagian because the goal of the story (saving a copy) can be reached through the print dialog, but 'download PDF' as a feature does not exist.
